item.title: Psalm 21 — Rejoicing in God’s Strength and the Victory of Christ
item.description: Dave Jenkins walks through Psalm 21, a psalm of gratitude and worship after God grants victory to His anointed king. This episode highlights joy in God’s strength, steadfast love, and how Psalm 21 points to the eternal reign of Jesus Christ.

item.title: What Is Biblical Discernment and Why It Matters
item.description: What is biblical discernment and why does it matter? In this episode of Contending for the Word Q&A, Dave Jenkins explains how believers test everything by the Word of God and grow in spiritual maturity. Anchored in Hebrews 5:14 and 1 Thessalonians 5:21, this episode explores why discernment is essential for Christian maturity, protection from deception, and love for truth.

item.title: How Scripture Equips Christians to Tell Truth from Error
item.description: How does Scripture train believers to recognize truth and reject error? In this episode of Contending for the Word Q&A, Dave Jenkins explains how God's Word reveals truth, exposes deception, renews the mind, and equips Christians to walk in biblical discernment according to 2 Timothy 3:16–17.

item.title: Mathematics and the Mind of God: Seeing the Creator in the Order of Creation
item.description: In this episode of Sound Theology and Discernment, Justin Peters speaks with Dr. T. (Ty) Dani Bradley about how mathematics reflects the order, coherence, and intelligibility of God’s creation and points to Christ who sustains all things.
